title: EXEC CICS RETURN ... IMMEDIATE (the next transaction attached at once, with the COMMAREA, without a terminal input) and LINK ... SYNCONRETURN (ignored on a local link); RETURN IMMEDIATE's INVREQ RESP2 1 and 2

scenarios.summary: RETURN TRANSID(PC52) COMMAREA(8) IMMEDIATE attaches PC52 at once with the COMMAREA; its own RETURN TRANSID (not immediate) waits for the next ENTER
LINK PROGRAM COMMAREA LENGTH SYNCONRETURN to a local program: the option is ignored, the link and its COMMAREA are as without it
RETURN IMMEDIATE in a LINKed program (not the highest logical level): INVREQ RESP2 2, and the program goes on
RETURN IMMEDIATE in a task started with no terminal: INVREQ RESP2 1, and the program goes on
